---
title: Bread Fritters
id: MAR-0041
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 85
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g stale bread
- 50 g flour
- 30 g raisins
- 1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk
- 2 tablespoons pine nuts
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Break the bread into pieces, put it in a pot, and cover it with water.
2. Salt lightly and cook over low heat for about 45 minutes, until the bread has dried completely.
3. Let cool.
4. Soak the raisins in warm water for 15 minutes, then squeeze them and add to the bread mixture.
5. Mix in the egg and yolk, stir, add the pine nuts, flour, salt, and pepper.
6. Heat plenty of oil and fry spoonfuls of the mixture, a little at a time.
7. Drain the fritters and place them on paper towels.
8. Salt them and serve hot.
